subject: literacy
concept: Writing a complete sentence with a capital letter, correct spacing, and ending punctuation
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student arranges word tiles into a sentence, adding a capital-letter tile and punctuation tile in the right places
exercise.pictorial: Student circles the correctly formatted sentence among several with errors
exercise.abstract: Student writes a complete, correctly formatted sentence from a prompt

misconception_flags: omits capital letter or ending punctuation

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
